method.selection: Qualify the fixed assignment from exploratory sweep one because it had the least exact hole count among the four disclosed synchronous best-response assignments. Do not rerun or claim convergence of the exploratory optimizer.
method.stopping_rule: After this declaration is committed, run the fixed-assignment producer once and the independently implemented source-first checker once. Retain the polish only if the checker reconstructs the frozen source, all three predecessor boundaries, complete 69-tile family, all 110,649,369,600 point outcomes, exact 127,991,562-hole improvement, and canonical nested residual root.

next_obligation: Compare the improved exact residual against factor-five and inherited-shift alternatives; only a zero-hole full-pool certificate can enter the frozen affine verifier.
nonclaims: This 69-tile assignment is not an exact cover.
The four-sweep synchronous best-response exploration did not converge.
The selected assignment is not coordinate-wise, joint, or globally optimal.
A bounded period-332640 residual is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
The producer and checker are not a Vela Verification or Decision.

preknowledge.disclosure: Four complete exact synchronous best-response sweeps were run before this qualification. They did not converge: changed-shift counts were 9, 6, 8, and 9, with exact hole counts 25,392,268,030; 25,264,276,468; 25,279,077,496; and 25,283,047,186. Sweep one was selected only because it had the least exact hole count.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit and no optimization label. Its retained value, if any, is independent qualification of one strictly improved fixed assignment plus a documented nonconvergence boundary.
